content.instructions: Choose the one correct answer for each question.

questions.prompt: Which sentence has the verb in the right place?
options: Ich denke, dass es ist wichtig.
Ich denke, dass ist es wichtig.
questions.explanation: In a clause with “dass”, the verb goes to the very end.

questions.prompt: Which sentence means “It is raining, so I am staying at home”?
options: Es regnet. Trotzdem bleibe ich zu Hause.
*Es regnet. Deshalb bleibe ich zu Hause.
Es regnet, dass ich zu Hause bleibe.
questions.explanation: “deshalb” gives the result; “trotzdem” means in spite of that.
The verb agrees with the thing you like: one picture gefällt, two pictures gefallen.
